question: Which public sector organisation is the largest provider of surface transport services in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Railways**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Indian Railways** is the largest provider of surface transport services in India, operating a vast network of trains across the country.
 
• Founded in **1853**, Indian Railways is one of the world's largest railway networks, with over 68,000 kilometers of track.
 
• It operates passenger trains, freight services, and suburban rail systems, connecting urban and rural areas efficiently.
 
• Indian Railways carries over **23 million passengers daily** and handles more than 1.2 billion tons of freight annually.
 
• It is managed by the Ministry of Railways, Government of India, and serves as a crucial backbone for India's economy and mobility.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Railways Zones:** The network is divided into **18 zones**, including Northern Railway, Southern Railway, Eastern Railway, and Western Railway, each managed by a zonal headquarters.
 
• **Freight Operations:** Indian Railways plays a vital role in transporting goods such as coal, iron ore, fertilizers, and agricultural produce across the country.
 
• **Employment:** Indian Railways is one of the largest employers globally, with over **1.3 million employees**.
 
• **Electrification:** More than **80% of India's railway network** is electrified, aiming for 100% electrification by 2030 as part of its sustainability goals.
 
• **Technological Advancements:** Indian Railways is continuously upgrading its infrastructure, introducing high-speed trains like **Vande Bharat Express** and improving passenger amenities.
